svg.text: Lessons from later projects: isolate what changes, keep boundaries, build frameworks from reuse
modem control smeared through 60,000 lines; a different new modem forced a hack
translating old bit patterns in the bus-write routine: isolate hardware from
UNIFY SQL calls smeared through C; when the product was cancelled, three months of
effort failed to move to another vendor: databases are details to isolate
services passing state through disk files; later an externalised state machine in a
text file started a new service per transition (OCP, hot-swapping, a BPEL), with a
layered with dependencies following flow of control, not toward policy; an object-
oriented database and over-architecture led to scrapping: size the architecture to
Architects Registry exam (ETS and NCARB): 18 vignettes, each a CAD-like GUI app plus a scorer; a 45,000-line framework built with the first application was not
reusable; a second 45,000-line framework built with four vignettes at once worked, vignettes as plugins following the Dependency Rule: you can't make a reusable
framework until you first make a usable framework.
